These Beta Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Wingman ("Wingman," the "Service," "we," "us," or "our"), a beta product operated by Shama Bildikar ("Operator").

1. About Wingman

Wingman is a beta service designed to help high-school students discover and organize extracurricular activities, competitions, internships, programs, and other educational opportunities.

Wingman may help users:

  • build a student profile based on information they provide;
  • identify opportunities that may be relevant to their interests, goals, and profile;
  • browse opportunities;
  • save opportunities to a personal tracker;
  • organize deadlines associated with opportunities;
  • generate tasks associated with those deadlines; and
  • otherwise organize aspects of their college-preparation journey.

Wingman is a productivity and discovery tool. It is not an educational institution, college admissions office, admissions counselor, attorney, financial adviser, or other professional adviser.

2. Eligibility and Parental Permission

Wingman is currently available only to individuals who are 13 years of age or older.

If you are under 18 years old, you may use Wingman only with the permission and involvement of your parent or legal guardian. By creating an account as a user under 18, you represent that your parent or legal guardian has given you permission to use Wingman and agrees to these Terms on your behalf where required by applicable law.

Parents and legal guardians may also create accounts and use Wingman.

You must provide truthful and accurate information about your age and eligibility. You may not create an account for someone else without appropriate authorization.

We reserve the right to request additional information or take reasonable steps to verify eligibility or parental permission.

3. Beta Program

Wingman is currently offered as an invite-only beta.

The beta is provided for testing, evaluation, and improvement of the Service. During the beta:

  • features may be incomplete or experimental;
  • the Service may contain bugs, errors, or inaccuracies;
  • features may change without notice;
  • information or recommendations may occasionally be missing, incorrect, outdated, or inappropriate;
  • the Service may become temporarily or permanently unavailable; and
  • we may discontinue or modify the beta at any time.

The beta is currently provided free of charge. We may introduce paid features, subscriptions, or other pricing in the future. If we do so, we will provide appropriate notice before charging you for a paid service.

You should not rely on Wingman as your sole source of information about an opportunity, deadline, eligibility requirement, or application.

4. AI-Generated Recommendations and Content

Wingman uses artificial intelligence and machine-learning technologies to provide portions of the Service.

For example, after you provide sufficient profile information, Wingman may use that information to help rank or recommend opportunities that may be relevant to you. Wingman may also generate profiles, activity suggestions, deadlines, tasks, descriptions, or other content.

AI-generated information can be inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or inappropriate. Recommendations are suggestions, not guarantees.

You are responsible for reviewing AI-generated information before relying on it or taking action based on it.

Wingman does not guarantee that any recommendation is suitable for you or that following a recommendation will improve your academic, extracurricular, educational, or college-admissions outcomes.

Conversational AI features may be introduced in the future and may be subject to additional terms or limitations.

5. Opportunity Information

Wingman may obtain information about opportunities from a combination of sources, including publicly available information, third-party sources, organizations, databases, and other sources.

We may attempt to review or verify opportunity information, but we do not guarantee that opportunity information is accurate, complete, current, legitimate, available, or appropriate for a particular user.

In particular, Wingman does not guarantee:

  • that an opportunity is still accepting applications;
  • that a deadline is accurate;
  • that eligibility requirements are accurate or complete;
  • that an opportunity is legitimate;
  • that an opportunity is free;
  • that an opportunity will remain available;
  • that you will be accepted into an opportunity; or
  • that an opportunity is appropriate for your particular circumstances.

You should independently verify important information directly with the organization offering an opportunity before applying, paying money, submitting personal information, or otherwise participating.

6. No Admissions Guarantee

Wingman does not provide admissions advice or guarantee admission to any college, university, program, competition, internship, or other organization.

Wingman's recommendations are based on information available to the Service and information you provide. They are not predictions of how an admissions officer or other decision-maker will evaluate you.

No statement made by Wingman should be interpreted as a representation that a particular activity, opportunity, profile, task, or recommendation will increase your likelihood of admission.
